sections.title: Get database actions
sections.text:
[code example]

Get the status of all currently executing or pending state-machine-related actions for a specific database. Completed actions are not returned, so an empty array means no actions are running for the database. This API tracks short-lived API requests that return `action_uid`.

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [view_status_of_cluster_action](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#view_status_of_cluster_action) |

#### Example HTTP request

[code example]

#### URL parameters

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| bdb_uid | string | Unique database ID |

sections.title: Response
sections.text:
Returns an array of JSON objects with attributes from [actions](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/action) and [state machines](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/state-machine). Completed actions and state machines are not included.

Each action contains the following attributes: `name`, `action_uid`, `status`, and `progress`.

sections.title: Status codes
sections.text:
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| [200 OK](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.2.1) | No error, response provides info about state-machine actions |
| [404 Not Found](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.4.5) | bdb not found |
